content:
**OPNduck v0.4.0-Beta** 🦆 - first Beta!

**New**
• Downloader: 8K/1440p, subtitles, dubbed audio tracks, whole channels/lists, sign-in for private content, Smart mode
• Subscriptions: auto-download new uploads while OPNduck is open
• AI Audio (Demucs): remove/extract vocals, isolate voice (big install, ~5.5 GB with CUDA)
• Library: search, filters, sorting, batch groups, JSON export/import
• ~2x faster UI

Beta: expect bugs. Windows installers untested on real Windows. Tauri still postponed.
